service_name: Annaka City Shared (Nori-ai) Taxi / AI New Transport
operating_days: Monday to Saturday (Closed: Sundays, Public Holidays, and Year-end/New Year holidays Dec 30 – Jan 3)

eligible_groups: Pre-schoolers (Up to 2 free per accompanying adult)

reservation_methods.allowed_to: Everyone (No prior registration required for standard service)
reservation_methods.note: For morning slots, book by 15:00 the previous day. For afternoon slots, book by 12:00 the same day.

reservation_methods.method: Smartphone App / LINE (AI New Transport Trial)
reservation_methods.allowed_to: Participants in the 'AI New Transport' demonstration area (Matsuida area)
reservation_methods.note: Reservations available from 7 days in advance until 20 minutes before departure.

reservation_window: From 1 day in advance (for morning) or same-day (for afternoon)
important_notes: Prior registration is NOT required for the standard shared taxi.
Registration IS required for the 'AI New Transport' trial service.
Service is restricted to one ride per hour per user.
Destinations outside defined zones are allowed for specific locations like Usui Hospital and local shopping centers (Yaoko/Sekichu).
Different service areas cannot be combined in a single ride.
